notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

You probably guessed it by now - with the events of the last years I have sadly been unable to finish the map editor.

That said, the current build of R42 is free of known bugs and contains all content and features planned when early access was released plus the ability to record and share replays. After contemplating for quite a while I came to the conclusion that it is time to leave early access and release the game. If I get the chance to finish the editor in the future, it will be free dlc.

Thank you to everyone that joined us in the early access journey!

Stay healthy! Stay safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/59bd8bf46ad7070f1e7c6f4aa0bc22162a10e5c1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Space 16
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Yes, we are not dead. Life happened. 2020 happened.
We are currently working on the editor used to make custom spaces that can be shared in the workshop. This is quite the time consuming process as custom spaces need to integrate into all other features smoothly.

In the meantime here is the last of the early access spaces made by us - Space 16.
Let us know what you think on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or community page.

Stay healthy! Stay safe!

notes.title: Ghost Workshop Support
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It took a while but the first half of workshop support is finished! You can now share your personal ghosts on the Steam Workshop for other players to view and race against.

To make this easier there is now a new sub-menu in the space select screen that allows management of local and downloaded ghosts per space.

We are looking forward to the amazing times and tricks to be seen in our community's ghosts!

As always let us know what you think on our [url=url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or community page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/59bd8bf46ad7070f1e7c6f4aa0bc22162a10e5c1.gif[/img]

Patchnotes:

- Ghost sub-menu in space select enabled
- Ghosts are now recorded to local storage
- Local ghosts can be activated, deactivated and deleted
- Ghosts can be published to the Steam Workshop
- Workshop ghosts can be activated and deactivated ingame

- The behavior of the loading screen has been improved
- Added new base skin
- Added new accessories

notes.title: Avatar Customization
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you might have realized we did not patch last week. We decided against bothering our players with a patch that would only remove the Halloween content and include some uncritical fixes. Especially since the skin will be back with this update anyway!

Entering avatar customization. Accessed through the 'skin' tab in the space select screen you can now change your base skin and attach some accessories to your digital body. This will influence how your ghosts look and your avatar in multiplayer sessions. This includes ghosts uploaded to the workshop for other players (feature not yet done). For now we have 4 base skins and 6 accessory variations with more to come.

We would also like to take this chance to announce that we will not be doing weekly patches going forward. That is because the remaining features (workshop!) will still take a lot of work and the core game is in a stable and very playable state. Of course we will release new spaces as soon as they are done. 

Any ideas for future skins or accessories? Let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or community page. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/e6ff55a741a383fe8fb476173d56432ed414d4f0.jpg[/img]

Patchnotes:

- Added avatar customization screen
- Added 4 base skins
- Added 6 accessory variations with 10 different colors each

- fixed the space record holder indicator for opponents sometimes not vanishing correctly
- improved bike control scheme description animation
- fixed gamepad controls image not showing the boost key

notes.title: Weekly Patch 09
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have a little treat for you (no tricks involved!).
The space select screen has been reworked and should be a lot easier to use now. We also included some settings and stats (ingame leaderboards!) for easy access.

One of those is especially interesting to our veteran players: a second speed setting.
In this mode your max speed as well as the effects of boosts are increased. You also have access to 3 manual boosts you can use on a button press. These refresh once you pass the finish line again.
Can you handle the new challenges this brings?

To accommodate for the higher speed and optional boosts we also reworked the player UI to better show your boosted speed and your remaining manual boosts.

As always let us know what you think on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or community page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/0cf3a0e8513ed3cb7f3a2ce6cff0f20a4d95ca77.gif[/img]

- Reworked player UI

- Added high speed setting
- Added ingame leaderboards to the space select screen
- Added a second batch of leaderboards for the high speed variant of spaces

notes.title: Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This week the first multiplayer mode made it into the game - Quickplay. As the name implies this will instantly get a game for you. The server will automatically throw up to 42 random players into the same space to compete and fill the remaining player slots with AI. Spaces will be rotated every 5 minutes. Of course if new players join and there is room, bots will get removed. Otherwise if there are more than 42 players, the server will try to reshuffle participants onto 2 different spaces.
Private games with friends and customized game settings for multiplayer games will follow at a later date.

I wish everyone a lot of fun with friends and strangers alike! Come say hi on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or steam community forums and find people to race with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/b8f5158acdd1e11f53e6c4aca84cfda4d8260164.png[/img]

Patchnotes:

- Multiplayer -> Quickplay mode unlocked
- Steam Rich Presence enabled so you can stalk your friends.

- Racer UI was adjusted for multiplayer. A reworked version will follow.
- Nameplates will show above competitors
- Boosts redesigned to more easily see on which side of a surface they are located.
- Redesigned space 08 to remove the altered gravity it had.

- improved performance on space 12
- improved environment on spaces 03 and 09
- improved origin calculations for spaces 01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 09 and 11

notes.title: Dataspace is here
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35599479/72d68f440dff5d7113e9203c57467ea803c45fc3.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

The unique property of dataspace is now in the game - all tracks behave like movement on a 4d torus would.

What does that mean you might ask. Imagine me moving on earth. If I go in one direction long enough, I will return to where I started sooner or later. Now include falling and flying in this somehow and you are pretty close to what this does.
Except for dataspace not being on a ball in space.

In practice this means you can see each track infinitely repeating itself in all directions and you can travel in all directions and will eventually get back to where you started (which means more crazy shortcut ideas).

Have fun!
